behavior_ja: initializerは入口のdictionary x2とarchive x3を一時retainし、入口receiverとproxy classでobjc_superを作り、superclass initを送る。
behavior_en: Initializer retains incoming dictionary x2 and archive x3, constructs objc_super with incoming receiver and proxy class, and sends superclass init.

behavior_ja: superclassの返値が非0の場合だけdictionary/archiveを+8/+16へobjc_storeStrongする。0の場合は両storeを飛ばす。通常終了で一時retainをreleaseし、superclassの返値を返す。
behavior_en: Nonzero superclass result receives objc_storeStrong at offsets8/16 for dictionary/archive respectively. Zero skips both stores. Normal path releases temporary retains and returns superclass result.

behavior_ja: Classes wrapperは入口のallowed-classes x2をkey x3へ上書きし、同じreceiverへdecodeObjectForKey:を送る。完全32B本文で元の制限引数を使わない。
behavior_en: Classes wrapper overwrites incoming x2 allowed-classes argument with incoming x3 key and sends decodeObjectForKey: to incoming receiver; original constraint is unused in this complete32B body.

behavior_ja: Class wrapperは入口のclass x2をkey x3へ上書きし、同じreceiverへdecodeObjectForKey:を送る。完全32B本文で元の制限引数を使わない。
behavior_en: Class wrapper overwrites incoming x2 class argument with incoming x3 key and sends decodeObjectForKey: to incoming receiver; original constraint is unused in this complete32B body.

behavior_ja: object decoderは+8のdecoderDictへ入口key x2でobjectForKeyedSubscript:を送る。辞書返値0の明示枝は0を返しarchive sendを飛ばす。
behavior_en: Object decoder sends objectForKeyedSubscript: to decoderDict at offset8 with incoming key x2. Explicit zero dictionary result branches to zero return and skips archive send.

behavior_ja: 辞書返値が非0なら+16のcvArchiveへ_decodedObject:のx2として渡す。辞書返値をreleaseしてarchive返値を返し、raw値fallbackや欠落時の追加archive検索を置かない。
behavior_en: Nonzero dictionary result becomes argument x2 of _decodedObject: sent to cvArchive at offset16. Archive result is returned after dictionary-result release; no local raw-value fallback or second missing-key archive lookup.

behavior_ja: IntegerはdecodeObjectForKey:の後にintValueを送り、返値w0をsigned32からsigned64へ符号拡張してobjectをreleaseし返す。局所的なnil・型・default枝なし。
behavior_en: Integer decoder sends decodeObjectForKey: then intValue, sign-extends32-bit w0 to64-bit x20, releases object and returns saved integer. It has no local nil/type/default branch.

behavior_ja: FloatはdecodeObjectForKey:の後にfloatValueを送り、s0をobject releaseの前後で保持する。局所的なnil・型・default枝なし。
behavior_en: Float decoder sends decodeObjectForKey: then floatValue and preserves s0 through object release; no local nil/type/default branch.

behavior_ja: DoubleはdecodeObjectForKey:の後にdoubleValueを送り、d0をobject releaseの前後で保持する。局所的なnil・型・default枝なし。
behavior_en: Double decoder sends decodeObjectForKey: then doubleValue and preserves d0 through object release; no local nil/type/default branch.

behavior_ja: BoolはdecodeObjectForKey:の後にboolValueを送り、x0をreleaseの前後で保持し、追加mask・比較なしで返す。metadataの返値はB。
behavior_en: Bool decoder sends decodeObjectForKey: then boolValue, preserves x0 through release and returns it without extra local mask/comparison; metadata result B.

behavior_ja: Bytesは入口x3をoutput pointerとして保存し、key objectをdecodeしてlengthを送り、64-bit x0をoutput pointerへ無条件格納する。局所的なnull guardなし。
behavior_en: Bytes decoder saves incoming x3 output pointer, decodes key object, sends length and unconditionally stores64-bit x0 through output pointer. No local output-pointer null guard.

behavior_ja: Bytesは保持objectをobjc_retainAutoreleaseへ渡し、その返値receiverへbytesを送り、保持objectをreleaseして保存pointerを返す。局所copyなし。実行時lifetime・native失敗は未確認。
behavior_en: Bytes decoder calls objc_retainAutorelease with retained object, sends bytes to returned receiver, releases retained object and returns saved pointer; no local copy. Runtime pointer lifetime/native errors unverified.

behavior_ja: Containsは辞書subscript返値の非0だけを判定し、release後0/1を返す。_decodedObject:を送らずarchiveでの復元可否を検査しない。
behavior_en: Contains only tests dictionary subscript result nonzero and returns0/1 after release. It never sends _decodedObject: or verifies archive decodability.

behavior_ja: Versionは+16のcvArchiveを読み、入口class-name x2を保ってversionForClassName:へtail sendする。局所default・失敗枝なし。
behavior_en: Version loads cvArchive offset16 and tail-sends versionForClassName: with incoming x2 class-name argument. No local default or failure branch.
Destructor clears archive offset16 then dictionary offset8 with objc_storeStrong zero arguments.

behavior_ja: class factoryはdictionary/archiveを一時retainし、入口class receiverをallocateする。その返値へinitWithDict:andCVArchive:を送り、一時retainをreleaseしてinitialization返値をautoreleaseする。
behavior_en: Class factory retains dictionary/archive, allocates incoming class receiver, sends initWithDict:andCVArchive: to allocation result, releases temporary retains and autoreleases initialization result.
